messages:
Priya (PM): Heads-up: three customer threads pushed private-deploy upgrade clarity to our roadmap. Need a concrete Q2 plan for VPC/on-prem packaging and upgrade choreography.
Sam (Eng): Concise ask summary: deterministic upgrade paths, minimal downtime, and clear firewall/nat handoff docs.
Maya (Eng-Infra): Major engineering constraint is stateful KV and model artifact churn. Two options: migrate-in-place with online schema transforms OR side-by-side instances with traffic switch.
Jordan (Solutions): From customers: acceptable to have a short drain window if we automate verification and rollback. They also want a prescriptive preflight checklist the infra team can hand to their NetOps.
Erin (Network): For VPC handoff we need to list required outbound ports, healthcheck URIs, and certificate rotation guidance. Some customers require a narrow egress policy and explicit flow log instructions.
Luis (Security): Security wants TLS cert lifecycle documented and HSM/KMS handshake examples. Also, include how to audit upgrade actions in our audit logs.
Priya (PM): Proposed Q2 deliverables: (A) Upgrade playbook (in-place + side-by-side + quarantine mode), (B) VPC handoff doc + example terraform + iptables samples, (C) Preflight CLI that runs checks, (D) Compatibility matrix covering model/quantization/runtime.
Sam (Eng): For the playbook: minor patches in-place with reversible DB migrations; major version moves via side-by-side and traffic cutover. Need a migration tool that supports streaming delta replication for KV.
Maya (Eng-Infra): Implementation note: build a migrate-kv binary with simulate/verify flags and an option to throttle replication. We can extract logic from Dedicated's migration libs but must strip extra telemetry.
Jordan (Solutions): Customer-facing runbook snippet request: short CLI flow so admins can follow steps. Example: ```
# preflight
redwoodctl preflight --target cluster
# drain
redwoodctl orchestrate drain --service private-deploy
# migrate
redwoodctl migrate-kv --from 1.8 --to 2.0 --verify
# cutover
redwoodctl cutover --strategy safe
```
Erin (Network): Network validation steps: curl --head https://private-host/health | grep ok, confirm TLS with openssl s_client -connect, validate egress to KMS endpoints, and test flow logs. Provide a terraform snippet for VPC peering and route tables.
Luis (Security): Add an audit step: ensure all redwoodctl actions record a trace id and that we surface it to customer logs for SSO-linked accounts. Also, include a short threat model for upgrade procedures.
DeployBot: CI note: created pipeline pipeline-upgrade-playbook-78 and scheduled integration tests against infra-sim-4. Logs: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/78 :white_check_mark:
Priya (PM): Launch criteria draft: 1) Migration tool validated in CI and on two internal clusters, 2) Preflight CLI passes simulated restricted network tests, 3) Pilot customers complete both minor in-place and major side-by-side upgrades, 4) Docs reviewed by Security and Network.
Sam (Eng): Rollback SLA: for minor versions aim for < 15m to restore previous serving nodes. For major versions rollback requires artifacts size estimate; add estimated time per GB to docs.
Maya (Eng-Infra): Suggest fast-quarantine: new nodes get isolated until KV replication hits a safe watermark; traffic stays on stable pool. This reduces blast radius and buys time for verification.
Jordan (Solutions): Field note: customers want an "approve and run" CLI output — basically a one-page checklist that sysadmins can execute. We should include a human-readable remediation list when preflight fails.
Erin (Network): I'll draft the VPC handoff with required SGs, NACLs, IP ranges, health endpoints, and a small iptables example for customers who run bastions.
Priya (PM): Prioritization: sprint 1 -> preflight CLI + minimal compatibility matrix; sprint 2 -> migrate-kv v0.1 + playbook draft + network docs; sprint 3 -> test harness + pilot coordination. Airgap installer will be scoped but deprioritized unless a signed pilot emerges. Agree?
Luis (Security): Agree on deprioritizing airgap for GA, but keep a security spec for airgapped installs (cert provisioning, offline KMS procedures).
Sam (Eng): We'll target migrate-kv API + simulate + verify flags by end of sprint 2. Will need Maya's test harness to run CI scenarios for rollback timing.
Maya (Eng-Infra): I'll build a restricted-network fixture and a harness to run upgrade+rollback, plus implement node quarantine.
Jordan (Solutions): I'll line up two pilot customers: one to test minor in-place upgrade and another to test side-by-side major upgrade. Will request contact from Customer Success.
Priya (PM): I'll create tickets: PD-401 (preflight CLI), PD-402 (migrate-kv tool), PD-403 (VPC handoff + terraform samples), PD-404 (test harness + infra fixtures). Assign owners.
Sam (Eng): One more: compatibility matrix should include columns for model file format, quantization profile, runtime ABI, and minimum runtime version. That should catch most surprises.
Luis (Security): Also include a column for required crypto modules (HSM vs software KMS) and any special cert chain needs.
Priya (PM): Great. I'll update the roadmap and post links to tickets and pilot plans here once they're created. Thanks all.
Jordan (Solutions): Thanks team.
Erin (Network): Thanks!
